nodes.name: Nd2Fe14B/C electrode material preparation
nodes.procedure: Nd2Fe14B magnetic powder obtained by means of high temperature demagnetization and the ball-milling, and then mixing Nd2Fe14B magnetic powder with starch solution, thus the Black Nd2Fe14B/C material, as part of an additional material of working electrode, was prepared by drying (110°C) and vacuum microwave sintering (1100°C, 2h).

nodes.source_text: Shi et al. obtained Nd2Fe14B magnetic powder by means of high temperature demagnetization and the ball-milling, and then mixing Nd2Fe14B magnetic powder with starch solution, thus the Black Nd2Fe14B/C material, as part of an additional material of working electrode, was prepared by drying (110°C) and vacuum microwave sintering (1100°C, 2h).

nodes.description: OER performance in alkaline media with magnetic field
nodes.source_text: Garces et al. revealed that a moderate applied magnetic field (≤450 mT) improves the electrocatalytic activity of magnetic anodes in alkaline media.[35] The anode current of NiZnFe4Ox is significantly enhanced in applying an external magnetic field. Specifically, the increment of current density is ≈100% at a working potential of 1.67 V . The promotion effect of an applied magnetic field on oxygen evolution reaction has proven further via a chronoamperometry measurement by successively moving and removing the magnet beside the electrode. It is worthy to note that an external magnetic field can significantly improve the performance of OER, and the long-term stable operation time more than 12 h

nodes.description: ORR electron pathway analysis with magnetic field
nodes.source_text: Zeng and others shown the increased number of exchanged electron pathway ( n = 3.92 at 1.32 mT vs 3.48 at 0 mT ) is obtained for the Co3O4/ECNFs modified electrodes under the magnetic field at a mT level, which is mainly a result from the magnetic field polarization on unpaired electron spin of Co3O4 and the electron energy degeneracy that facilitates a faster rate of oxygen reduction by the Co3O4/ECNFs to fulfill a 4-electron pathway during the ORR process.

nodes.description: Charge transfer performance with magnetic field
nodes.source_text: Zeng et al. discussed the magneto-supercapacitance mechanism and found that the paramagnetic nature of the MnO2 with multiple unpaired electrons and magnetic susceptibility significantly improves the electron transfer of a pseudo-redox reaction of Mn(IV)/Mn(III) at the electrode thus improves the pseudo-reactions of MnO2 at the electrode and interfaces in the presence of a 1.34 mT magnetic field.

nodes.description: HER/OER performance with high-frequency alternating magnetic field
nodes.source_text: The overpotentials for HER and OER are reduced by ≈100 and 200 mV under a 48 mT magnetic field, respectively. The applied magnetic field can reduce the battery voltage of water electrolysis at different battery currents by 100-200 mV. The specific absorption rate of Fe2.2C-Ni is still greater than 2000 W g-1 under a 47 mT of magnetic field

Researches on ferromagnetic catalysts modified by iron oxides and Fe-N-C shown that the ORR current increases with the increasing of magnetic field intensity from 0 to 0.56 mT as shown in Figure 9a-c.
The HER overpotential of (FexNi1-x)9S8 at 10 mA cm-2 dropped sharply from 377 to 138 mV as the reaction temperature increased from 0 to 90°C under otherwise identical conditions
